harnessNotes: Three complete lawful Soldier1 fixtures began with actual starting dice3 before RNG. Source held its actual qualified Great sword; Counter held its qualified Boar spear; all proficiency picks and choices were complete. Source used a real first-half-action Great sword Standard Attack and its listed Massive3 self-inflicted Initiative loss20→17, preserving active source while order changed from original0/Counter1 to Counter0/original1. Its remaining half action was an ordinary Trip; defensive Counter natural20 was paid with one real die3→2. Main applied original flat-footed and earned one free counter. Actual free Counter-Trip off own Count had Spear+2/ACP/error+1 and rolled20 using the controlled CONFIG.Dice.randomUniform face seam through the actual Actor/Roll/card pipeline; its source post-stamp was deliberately failed, then actual Main GC review reattached the exact posted root without RNG. Original Great Sword+2 defended the counter while flat-footed. Counter won critically and paid its second real die2→1; Main added original sprawled and earned one final attack. Actual final Standard Attack at normal−4 off own Count rolled5 using that same controlled face seam and was finished as an ordinary miss; shared final allowance1 and no further die cost. Original counter and final were read-only retried before/after exact reload; second-step defensive record could not grant a third Trip. Original flat-footed+sprawled and all real losses were preserved until fixture deletion. Health4/4, source weapons, Counter19/Spare5 and source Count17 retaining Massive3 stayed unchanged. No health, dice or initiative baseline was reset and no damage ledger was initialized. The melee-stance/ordinary-Trip exit ruling remains pending; this native test deliberately uses the actual Massive loss in normal stance rather than assuming that ruling. Same-active-parent Power/index reordering is automated coverage, not claimed as native here.
